work.agent_query: Read AGENT_TASK.md and docs/INTERFACE.md. AGENT_TASK.md specifies a DanceGRPO training recipe for Wan2.2-TI2V-5B completely (the Dance-SDE transition, seed groups with a canonical RNG, the official HPSv3 video reward, the advantage, the loss and the optimizer). Implement it exactly in the supplied miles_diffusion checkout (repo/, including repo/task_entry.py and the whitelisted engine files under repo/engine_overlay/). That is the entry condition, not the score: the score is 0 unless every check passes and the final model of your real training run keeps its held-out HPSv3 reward no more than 0.28 below the original model's (a gate, not a multiplier). Then maximize the score: how many times per hour the part you own of the fixed replay (reward scoring, old-log-prob recompute, CFG training, AdamW, full-weight publication) completes on the two H100 GPUs (3600 / T), without changing what is sampled or trained. Check your work with python /opt/wan_public/run_public.py (suites cpu, score, probe, small, perf, full; outputs under /scratch/public). Keep notes in notes.md. Submit with sforge-submit; in shared mode, where the Judge uses your two GPUs, stop every GPU process before submitting.

dual-cuda-sm90-nccl.notes: Work and Judge serialize on the same leased pair; the Judge pauses Work while it runs. Floor 90 GiB per card (P3, measured on the H100 NVL qualification pair): the reference's per-card peak is 87780 MiB (85.7 GiB) in the replays, with the Judge-owned engine and the colocated HPSv3 worker on the same card, so an 80 GB card cannot run it. The Judge's held-out quality eval (after the candidate stopped) peaks at 75835 MiB on GPU 0 (a clean engine plus HPSv3).

dual-cuda-sm90-nccl-80g.notes: The 80 GB H100 SXM pair (NV18, 700 W; 81559 MiB per card). Qualified separately (2026-10-10): runtime/qualification.dual-cuda-sm90-nccl-80g.json and the private root md-wandance/private/v2-h100-80g (the v2-h100 data and thresholds, its qualification.json naming this profile); scores are comparable only within this profile. The reference fits only with reference/miles_diffusion_wan_h100_80g.patch (the run's own engine keeps its text encoder in host memory; the colocated HPSv3 weights leave the GPU between scorings): per-card peaks 79993 MiB in RUN (untimed), 72012 MiB in the timed SERVE replays, 75840 MiB in the Judge's quality eval.
